title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a single loop containing a circle centered at coordinates (0.004, 0.004) with a radius of 0.004 units. Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0081. Ensure that the scaled sketch is rotated and translated using the same Euler angles and translation vector as initially set. Extrude the scaled 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a cylindrical base. Do not extrude in the opposite direction. This extrusion will form a new solid body with a length and width of 0.008064516129032258 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the circular sketch
circle_center = (0.004, 0.004)
circle_radius = 0.004
sketch = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder_height = 0.75
cylinder = sketch.extrude(cylinder_height)

# Create the small rectangular section at the top
rect_length = 0.008064516129032258
rect_width = 0.008064516129032258
rect_height = 0.01  # Assuming a small height for the rectangular section

# Move to the top of the cylinder to create the rectangular section
top_face = cylinder.faces(">Z").workplane()

# Create the rectangular sketch
rect_sketch = top_face.rect(rect_length, rect_width)

# Extrude the rectangular sketch
rect_extrusion = rect_sketch.extrude(rect_height)

# Combine the cylinder and the rectangular section
r = cylinder.union(rect_extrusion)

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the cylindrical section
cylinder = (
    workplane
    .center(0.004, 0.004)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.004)         # Create a circle with radius 0.004
    .extrude(0.75)         # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
)

# Create the rectangular section
rectangle = (
    workplane
    .center(0.004, 0.004)  # Move to the center of the rectangle
    .rect(0.0081, 0.0081)  # Create a rectangle with the given dimensions
    .extrude(0.01)         # Extrude the rectangle to create a small protrusion
)

# Combine the cylindrical and rectangular sections
r = cylinder.union(rectangle)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius
r = r.center(0.004, 0.004).circle(0.004)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Create a new workplane at the top of the cylinder
r = r.faces(">Z").workplane()

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius
r = r.center(0.004, 0.004).circle(0.004)

# Extrude the circle to create a small protrusion
r = r.extrude(0.01)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
r = r.combine()  # Combine all features into a single solid

import cadquery as cq

# Main shaft: slender square cross-section with slightly rounded corners
shaft = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.001, 0.0).lineTo(0.0071, 0.0) \
    .threePointArc((0.0081, 0.001), (0.0081, 0.001)) \
    .lineTo(0.0081, 0.0071) \
    .threePointArc((0.0071, 0.0081), (0.0071, 0.0081)) \
    .lineTo(0.001, 0.0081) \
    .threePointArc((0.0, 0.0071), (0.0, 0.0071)) \
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.001) \
    .threePointArc((0.001, 0.0), (0.001, 0.0)) \
    .close().extrude(0.75)

# Small head on top of the shaft, same footprint with rounded top edge
head = cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, 0.75)).rect(0.0081, 0.0081).extrude(0.01)
head = head.edges("|Z").fillet(0.001)
head = head.edges(">Z").fillet(0.002)

# Combine shaft and head
r = shaft.union(head)
